name: Photography project: sonder
source:
It's only the start of the year, and you are already falling behind.

Your photography teacher requested the homework you have yet to send; a series of photographs linked to a subject important in your work.

On a whim, you decide to head near the river outside of town and seek inspiration in the scenery there. By an unsuspected turn of events, you cross roads with a sweet stranger named Zechariah, who believes he could be of help.


[From [url=https://lcs-scar.itch.io/photography-project-sonder]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这只是今年的开始，你已经落后了。

你的摄影老师要求你交出尚未交的作业；与你作品中重要主题相关的一系列照片。

一时兴起，你决定前往城外的河边，从那里的风景中寻找灵感。出乎意料的是，你遇到了一个名叫撒迦利亚的可爱陌生人，他相信自己可以提供帮助。


[来自[url=https://lcs-scar.itch.io/photography-project-sonder]itch.io[/url]]
